'''Praster Ommlen''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Ottegan]] [[Smuggler|gunrunner]] who gave up crime and joined the [[Sacred Order of Ramulus]] sect of worship. Around thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]], he spent time in the castle of the [[pirate]] [[Maz Kanata]], offering spiritual advice to the other criminals there. He was present at the castle when the smuggler [[Han Solo]] arrived, and soon after witnessed the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destruction]] of the [[Hosnian system]] by the [[First Order]]'s [[Starkiller Base]].

==Biography==
An [[Ottegan]] from [[Ottega]],<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition" /> Praster Ommlen worked as a [[Smuggler|gunrunner]] before putting his life of crime behind him and becoming a devotee of the [[Sacred Order of Ramulus]], an [[Ithorian]] sect of worship. Around thirty [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor]], Ommlen spent time in the [[Takodana Castle|castle]] of the [[pirate]] [[Maz Kanata]], where he offered spiritual advice to other criminals. While there he connected with the [[Narquois]] bandit [[Pru Sweevant]] and the [[Bravaisian]] [[gemologist]]s [[Munduri]] and [[Sonsigo]].<ref name="TFAVD" />

He was present in the castle for the arrival of the [[smuggler]] [[Han Solo]], who was accompanied by the [[scavenger]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]], the former [[First Order stormtrooper|stormtrooper]] [[Finn]] and the [[astromech droid]] [[BB-8]]. As Solo entered, [[Varmik]] (one of the [[Hassk triplets]]) approached Ommlen, who then moved to watch a game of [[droid ball fighting]] being played. The game was interrupted when Kanata herself spotted Solo and yelled to him across the room, causing Ommlen and the room's other occupants to all fall silent and turn to look at the subject of Kanata's cry.<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref>

He was amongst the crowd of patrons that rushed out of the castle to watch the [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destruction]] of the [[Hosnian system]] by the [[First Order]]'s [[Starkiller Base]] [[superweapon]]. Shortly after the terrifying spectacle ended, the castle itself was [[Battle of Takodana|attacked]] and destroyed by the First Order.<ref name="TFA" />

==Personality and traits==
While at Maz Kanata's castle, Ommlen wore faded [[Color|brown]] [[Clothing|ascetic robes]], which offered him little comfort. He had brown skin, black [[eye]]s and gray [[hair]].<ref name="TFAVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Praster Ommlen was created for the [[2015]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']],<ref name="TFA" /> but was first revealed to the public seven months before the film's release in an exclusive [http://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/2015/05/star-wars-force-awakens-photos article] on the website of [[Wikipedia:Vanity Fair|''Vanity Fair'']] in [[May]] [[2015]],<ref name="Vanity Fair">{{WebCite|url=https://www.vanityfair.com/hollywood/2015/05/star-wars-force-awakens-photos|text=Adam Driver and Lupita Nyong'o's Characters Revealed in Exclusive Star Wars: The Force Awakens Photos|author=Leibovitz, Annie|date=2015-05-04|archivedate=20200815062211}}</ref> Ommlen was not identified in the article or film, but was then named in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="TFAVD" /> He was portrayed by [[Mason Ball]] and Richard Garaghty in the film.<ref name="The Cloud Riders">{{WebCite|url=https://thecloudriders.net/2018/07/06/mason-ball-the-force-awakens-interview-praster-ommlen|text=Mason Ball The Force Awakens Interview – Praster Ommlen|nobackup=1}}</ref>
